chars.WIFE: WIFE: a young Moroccan woman wearing a mustard-yellow djellaba and a dark brown hijab, carrying a black leather handbag.
chars.HUSBAND: HUSBAND: a young Moroccan man wearing a white t-shirt covered in paint stains, grey work trousers and worn sneakers, paint splashes on his arms.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Seen from across a narrow Moroccan street, head-to-waist framing: the WIFE walks quickly past a small closed beauty salon with its metal shutter pulled down, clutching her handbag, glancing nervously back over her shoulder, sneaky expression. Daytime, Agadir-area town street.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Close medium shot in a modest Moroccan kitchen: the WIFE secretly stuffs a thick bundle of banknotes into her black handbag, looking sideways to check nobody sees her, guilty eyes.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: The HUSBAND trudges in through the front door of a small Moroccan apartment in the evening, exhausted, shoulders slumped, paint bucket and brush in hand.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: The HUSBAND sits on the edge of a bed in a simple bedroom, staring sadly at his rough cracked hands covered in dried white paint, tired and worried.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Night, dark bedroom lit by blue moonlight: the HUSBAND lies awake on the bed, eyes wide open, staring at the ceiling, thinking hard, suspicious frown.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Night: seen from a dark hallway, the HUSBAND stands in the shadow watching the front door open as the WIFE sneaks in quietly with her handbag, surprised to see him awake.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Living room with Moroccan sofas: the HUSBAND rummages through the black handbag, the WIFE lunges toward him with arms out to grab the bag back, shocked and shouting.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Living room: the HUSBAND holds up a bundle of banknotes and confronts the WIFE angrily; the WIFE steps back, hands raised, about to cry.
